ValidationRule.description: When Credit Signature Accepts for Co-Branded Cards, the Membership Id cannot be empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Region_Flag__c) =='Bahrain', ISCHANGED(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c , "Accept"), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), TEXT(cc_Control_Type__c) == "STP", ISPICKVAL(cc_Requested_Card_Type__c, "ILA_GULF_AIR_COBRAND_01"), Has_Co_Brand_Membership_Number__c = true, (ISBLANK(cc_Embossing_Line_4__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please send the case to the contact center to collect and validate Co-brand Membership Number
